usageNotes: Use this endpoint to enumerate all PCI devices physically present on a node — essential before configuring PCI passthrough (PCIe PT) or mediated device (mdev) assignments for VMs. The node must be online and reachable; the caller needs either Sys.Audit or Sys.Modify at the root path. Bridge, memory controller, and processor-class devices are filtered out by default; pass a custom pci-class-blacklist (or an empty string) if you need those classes included.

examples.summary: List all PCI devices on node 'pve1' with full vendor/device names

tips: An iommugroup value of -1 means IOMMU is not active or the device is not grouped — passthrough will not work without IOMMU enabled in BIOS and the kernel (intel_iommu=on / amd_iommu=on).
Devices with mdev: true support mediated-device (vGPU) slicing, not just full passthrough — check this field before deciding on a passthrough strategy.
Set verbose: false for a quick ID-only list when scripting; use verbose: true (the default) when you need vendor/device names for documentation or VM config.
To include normally-filtered classes (e.g., bridges), pass pci-class-blacklist as an empty string or omit the classes you want visible.
